resources.name: Buckingham pair potential parameters for SrLaTiAlO6

access.notes: Fully specified in the instruction: Sr-O A=682.172 ρ=0.39450 C=0; Ti-O A=2179.122 ρ=0.30384 C=8.986; La-O A=2088.79 ρ=0.3460 C=23.25; Al-O A=1725.20 ρ=0.28971 C=0.0; O-O A=9547.96 ρ=0.21916 C=32.0 (A in eV, ρ in Å, C in eV·Å⁶). Formal charges: Sr +2, Ti +4, La +3, Al +3, O -2.
Any MD package that supports Buckingham potentials, Ewald summation, geometry relaxation, and nudged elastic band (NEB) calculations. LAMMPS is recommended.
